diagnosis: Under Castella arXiv:2312.01481's exact theorem hypotheses, generalized-Kato nonvanishing is not an analytic-only successor bridge. Nonvanishing forces Selmer dimension two; with dimension two it is equivalent to nonzero loc_p; the class itself spans ker(loc_p). Hence the successor route re-enters the prior BSD-A1a2 localization/positive-rank residual in a sharper transverse-localization form.
episode_vs_diagnosis_boundary: The episode records what was tried and observed. This record interprets the observation as route re-entry; it is not itself a reusable obstruction or lesson.
